provenance.source: Kiro Spec agent system prompt, the '### 1. Requirement Gathering' block, extracted from the shipped Kiro agent bundle (AWS does not publish it). Corroborated character-for-character by two independent extractions.
provenance.note: The authentic instruction text Kiro runs for the requirements phase, not documentation prose. Provenance is bundle-extraction, not an official AWS publication; flagged rather than hidden. Behaviour is draft-first: Kiro MUST generate an initial requirements draft WITHOUT asking sequential questions first, then iterate, so questions are demoted to SHOULD/MAY. There is no separate 'Analyze Requirements' step (that is a later, separate Kiro feature, not part of this prompt). The approval gate uses an IDE 'userInput' tool that is inert here; the runner's interview loop stands in for the review iterations.
